request-prompt: Expand the 'Meer om te vragen' (People also ask) and 'Mensen zoeken ook naar' sections by default so I can discover related questions and subtopics without clicking.
goal: I like to start with broad search terms and use search engine suggestions, related questions, and knowledge panels to browse and discover new aspects of a topic.
jobs: I want to find out where and when the 'Cats' musical is playing in the Netherlands.
I want to purchase tickets for the upcoming 2026 production of the 'Cats' musical.
I want to research the history, albums, and members of the Dutch pop group 'The Cats' from Volendam.
I want to watch promotional videos, trailers, or past performances of the 'Cats' musical.
I want to check the cast, characters, and song list of Andrew Lloyd Webber's musical 'Cats'.
I want to browse and download cute images of cats (the animal).
I want to see reviews and ratings for the 2019 movie adaptation of 'Cats' to decide if it is worth watching.
I want to explore other famous musicals written by the same composer, such as 'The Phantom of the Opera' or 'Starlight Express'.

preference-pairs.a: I prefer quick, visual, and interactive media formats like YouTube trailers, image grids, and teaser videos to understand a topic.
preference-pairs.b: I prefer reading structured, text-heavy encyclopedic content and official overviews (like Wikipedia or Britannica) to get detailed facts.

preference-pairs.a: I prioritize finding local, regional results and content in my native language, even if the query is a common English word.
preference-pairs.b: I lean towards global English-language platforms and databases (like IMDb or international blogs) because they usually offer higher quality and more comprehensive information.

preference-pairs.a: I like to start with broad search terms and use search engine suggestions, related questions, and knowledge panels to browse and discover new aspects of a topic.
preference-pairs.b: I prefer typing highly specific, precise queries from the start and find mixed, ambiguous search result pages frustrating to navigate.

preference: I like to start with broad search terms and use search engine suggestions, related questions, and knowledge panels to browse and discover new aspects of a topic.
